mcat_image_suggestions.prompt_for_generation: Professional product photograph of a large custom-engineered heavy structural steel assembly in a fabrication workshop: prominent welded steel frame comprising H-columns, plate girders, and horizontal beams in grey primer-coated mild steel, arranged as an industrial plant structural bay frame, clean white or light grey studio background, sharp front-three-quarter view, even industrial lighting highlighting weld seams and bolt connections, no workers or scaffolding, photorealistic, square 1:1 format.
